verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs confirm merge requests are a core feature (used for code review, agent-created MRs, and security findings surfacing in MRs) and the platform covers the full source-control-to-CI/CD lifecycle, implying MR-based collaboration. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit documentation of the discussion/comment threads, approval rules, or merge mechanics themselves. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on MR creation/review discussion threads, approval workflows, and merge conflict resolution, plus independent corroboration of the review experience.
